The '''City of Tear''' is the capital of the [[Tear|nation of the same name]]. 

== Description ==
Tear is considered the greatest port city upon the [[Sea of Storms]], located above the mouth of the [[River Erinin]] and guarded by the [[Stone of Tear]].{{ref/book|bwb}} It is large as [[Caemlyn]] and [[Tar Valon]], but not considered as beautiful as either.{{ref/book|1|48}}

There was once an [[Ogier grove]] outside Tear, but now it is empty pasture.{{ref/book|bwb}}

== History ==
Tear is one of the oldest cities in the world. The [[Stone of Tear]] was built very shortly after the [[Breaking of the World]], and never fell to invaders in millennia until the coming of the Dragon Reborn.

During the Compact of the [[Ten Nations]], Tear was part of the nation of [[Essenia]]. After the [[Trolloc Wars]], it was part of [[Moreina]].
